On 6th august 2026 i had to say a final farewell to my beloved cat bertie whom i rescued as a kitten on a rainy night 14 years ago due to a tumour he developed on his face, throughout that 14 years he gave me nothing but joy and love and it broke my heart to make the desicion, the staff, nurses and vets made it easier by showing care and compassion. thank you.
David leavy

This was my first experience at this vet and unfortunately it was not a great experience. I had to make a last minute appointment somewhere due to my dog being injured so I am grateful they accommodated me. However, I found the staff at the front very unfriendly and unprofessional. When the vet saw my dog I felt she was unsure of what to do and how to handle my dog.  I left feeling a bit like it was a waste of time and not helpful for my dog.
Overall, I will not be coming back to this vet and wouldn’t recommend going here if your pet has any urgent issues.

I honestly can’t thank the team at Village Vets Kilmainham enough for everything they have done for Bart. We brought him to them after an absolutely terrifying few days when he had been extremely unwell, and we were genuinely so scared about what was going to happen. They helped us get our Bart back from a really scary place, and seeing him doing so well now means more to us than I can put into words.

A huge thank you especially to Nicky, Lucy, Amber and Val, who were all so kind, reassuring and caring throughout everything. They never made us feel like we were being a nuisance for worrying or asking questions, and you could tell that Bart wasn’t just another patient to them.

I also want to thank all of the nurses who looked after him, comforted him and gave him so much care. The compassion shown not only to Bart but to us as his very worried family was incredible.

When your dog is part of your family, handing them over when they are sick is frightening. Knowing Bart was surrounded by people who genuinely cared made such a difference. We will never forget what Village Vets Kilmainham did for him.

Thank you for helping us get our cheeky, happy Bart back. 🐾❤️ We are incredibly grateful to every single one of you and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Village Vets Kilmainham to anyone.
Thank you for the 5-star review, Dora!
First visit..everyone was was kind and my two dogs received excellent service/treatment
Great vets, great service at a reasonable price. We pay the €25 monthly insurance with them and it’s worth it 100%

I chose this veterinary practice because of their 12-month subscription plan, which costs €23 per month. This plan covers everyday issues, planned visits, and offers discounts on anything not included. Vet bills can be astronomical, so having an affordable plan like this provides unmatched peace of mind. To top it all off, the staff are all lovely to work with
Kim&Lucy, Out of 10. 11. FirstClass Service.

I can’t recommend Martha highly enough.

We were referred to Martha during a really difficult few months with our dog, Lexi. We were getting a lot of information from different places, facing some tough decisions, and honestly felt completely overwhelmed.

Martha got in touch with us by chance when our local Village Vets was understaffed, and we’re so thankful to this day that we got that call. From our very first conversation she was the opposite of everything we’d experienced up to that point - calm, honest, reassuring and positive, while still being completely realistic. She was also incredibly generous with her time and was always happy to answer questions and explain things properly.

When it came to surgery, Martha always focused on what was best for Lexi. She felt Lexi would be happier recovering at home with her family rather than spending unnecessary time in hospital, and looking back I’m so glad we listened to her.

The surgery removed Lexi’s bladder stones and polyp, although unfortunately there was a complication when one stone became lodged in her urethra. Watching Lexi go through that was heartbreaking, but Martha was there every step of the way with advice, reassurance and support.

Today Lexi is back to her happy, energetic self, and honestly I don’t think we’d have our girl running around full of life without Martha. We’ll always be grateful for everything she did for Lexi and for us.

My dog Yanni was v ill,and it could have been worse,but for the prompt diagnosis given by Valerija.She was in UCD Vet Hospital for a week,where she also received excellent care.She is back to her feisty self.Thank you to all involved in her care

My 1 year old son Goob was recently neutered in Kilmainham Village Vets, the service couldn’t have been better. From the initial consultation right through to his check up appointment, the girls were brilliant. They made sure both Goob and I felt at ease. Goob wasn’t even reluctant to attend his post op appointment! He was delighted to see the staff again. I was thoroughly informed prior to and throughout the process and felt very supported by the staff, they encouraged I reach out over text/call if I had any queries or needed any additional medication. 10/10 overall and should Goob require any future treatment, we will definitely return to village vets kilmainham. Thank you to the whole team for making what was a nerve racking experience, a seamless one instead.
Friendly and kind staff, really like the way they treat my pet with love. Recommend 100%!!!

Dr Marta was so lovely with our kitten Luna at Village Vets Kilmainham! On the initial visit and during an emergency visit yesterday- the admin team were so efficient in giving us a last minute emergency appointment, the nurse was caring and Marta was so amazing. Luna is so lucky!

While Lucy the vet was amazing, I am transferring away from Village Vets to an independent vet.  l called to get a presciption and was told they'd have to ask the vet. Grand.  Heard nothing for 2 days (my dog has pulmonery hypertension) and when I called again, I was told "there's a note here to bring her in" Why did I not get a call?  Since Village Vets took over from Carey & Keane, the service has deteriorated and costs have spiralled.  Corporations buying up vet services is rampant in this country and I'm not partaking any more.  See also Independent Vet Care (IVC) Ireland Ltd and Linnaeus (Mars Inc.) - check the footnotes of your vet's website for these names.

My dog Paddy very nearly died a few months ago. It turned out he had a very aggressive cancer called Hemangiosarcoma (HSA) which was discovered during blood testing. I got a call while at work from Marte my vet. It was a devastating shock but she needed an answer to ‘do I let him go now while he is under or do I remove his spleen’. Paddy was 14. I couldn’t breathe, distraught and completely useless, so I asked her if she was me, what she would do. I’d probably remove the spleen. It may be contained. Theres always hope and it will give you more time. So she did. His spleen was riddled. The life span after HSA no longer than 89 days generally. That was 6 months ago and he is running around like a pup still. Im so grateful for that. Another vet saw his fresh scare and said and I quote; ‘That surgeon is very skilled’. Murphy got most of his teeth out yesterday and he was treated with such kindness, patience and care. The team are highly skilled, honest, open, kind, realistic, empathetic and just brilliant at what they do. Village vets in Kilmainham has a lovely team with a family atmosphere which I trust 100% to mind my 2boys. Thank you Marte and everyone there so very much, Gerry, Paddy & Murphy ❤️🐶🐶🙋🏼‍♀️

Went here to get a pre spray consultation for our kitten we found. Nurse very friendly, helpful and knowledgeable about any questions and about the procedure.
Kitten is booked for next week Delighted with the veterinary staff and clinic

I brought a stray dog to this clinic at 8am after finding him running in traffic. I was on my way to work and asked if they could hold the dog for one hour until the dog warden opened at 9am. The manager refused, stating they were not a shelter, and offered no empathy or practical advice on how to keep the dog safe. I was left in the position of trying to prevent a vulnerable animal from being put back onto a busy road while needing to get to work. I understand policies exist, but the complete lack of compassion or willingness to help in any way was extremely disappointing, especially from a veterinary practice.

Thankful for the team at Village Vets. Our vet, Marte, has been excellent and we are eternally grateful. Having a puppy with several health issues hasn’t been easy, but knowing we have a vet like Marte who is so knowledgeable and empathetic has made things so much easier. I truly know my dog, Fig, is in safe hands with the team here. You can see the love they have for their patients, and it eases my anxious mind every time my dog has to go in again!
The staff at reception are so lovely too. Everyone here is so caring, highly recommend choosing them as your vets.

We have been going here for years.About a year ago they discovered that my dog Toby had a heart condition. They have looked after him very well-seeing specialist's, x-ray's,ultrasound' s,blood tests and on going medication. He has just turned 10 and is doing great.I highly recommend this company.
More recently my dog got very sick very quickly and thanks to the Vet who saved his life by sending us immediately to the Vet Hospital in UCD for further tests and scans and life saving treatment for his inflamed gall bladder. Toby stayed there for 2 days and spent another day in the Kilmainham Vets on IV fluids,treatment drugs and pain killers .The following day they gave Toby an injection so he could attend my son's wedding  and continue his treatment at home. I don't have words to thank you enough for all that Martha and her team did for my dog Toby!

March 2025
My dog is nearly 12 now despite his near brush with death with an inflamed gall bladder above and his 3 year old heart murmur and the occasional knee injury and a couple of eye infections he has been doing  very well the last few years  with the absolutely brilliant work of Marte and her team at Kilmainham Village Vets and their treatments which have included specialist treatment for inflamedgall bladder and heart murmurs like heart specialists,ultrasound scans,X-ray's . ect.I don't have  enough words to thank you for all that you have done for my dog Toby over all these years!!I highly recommend Marte and her team at Village Vets Kilmainham!!!

July 2025

We were able to see the Vet in a matter of hours as I was worried about Toby when he had a bad case of diarrhoea and there was fresh blood on his bottom!The vet examined thoroughly and said that he had picked up a bad stomach infection that he picked up from other dogs possibly. He had been at the groomers the previous day. His stomach was very painful and she gave him an injection for the pain.The Vet has given some meds  to take at home some tablets to take every 8hours and some special food and we are due to return next Tuesday or come immediately if he gets worse!Thank you so much for looking after Toby so well!Every one of the staff have been so good to us both again!!I highly recommend the vets and all the staff at the Village Vets Kilmainham!

January 2026.
My Dog  Toby spit up an orange liquid for 2 days running and I thought it was his inflamed gall bladder coming back so we got to see Marte as soon as possible but luckily it was an upset stomach which cleared quickly with meds.He also had an eye infection and that is also clearing up with eye drops.My 12 and half year old toy poodle is now like a 2 year old with all the fantastic care he has received from Marte  and her team at the Village Vets Kilmainham since he was a puppy!I highly recommend Marte and her team and all the staff at the Village Vets Kilmainham!

Always have a wonderful experience with Village Vets Kilmainham. They always give the best care and advice in regard to my cat Loki. I really appreciate their honesty, kindness and transparency.
Thank you so much from me and Loki.

Avoid if possible, this vet uses people’s pets for financial gain.
My cat needed 2 vaccines, but Village Vets turned it into 4 because the repeatedly forgot to send reminders which they told us they would, therefore doubling the price from €140 to €280. Wouldn’t say it was an accident as it happened repeatedly.

We didn’t get as much as an apology and offering 10% off one vaccine just simply isn’t good enough, especially when you are at fault for the price of 2 extra vaccines.

I phoned village vets asking the speak with the manager about the matter as we were both very frustrated and disappointed this this vets was trying to charge us double the cost for something that was their own fault. I was told the manager is in a meeting, but she will call you back after.
That was 10 days ago, I never heard a thing from them.
As I said, do avoid if possible.

Hello Village Vets,
I have proof of phone records from my phone company to prove there was no attempt to call me on 07/01/2026 at 12.59pm and no voicemails received. To note, I phoned to discuss the matter on 31/12/25 and was told I would get a call back that day.
In addition, regardless of an appointment on 27th of December, there’s was no form of confirmation or communication to inform us of the appointment (how do we know to attend an appointment that we haven’t been told about) and this was at the fault of Village Vets. I was explicitly told I would get confirmations of the appointment as well as reminders.
If you are going to say that reminders are an aid to customers, then you’re staff are giving false information and need to be trained to advise customers that of this, because this is not what I was told.
Excellent care taken of Jake again.  They are very knowledgable, efficient but caring too. Jake doesn't mind going there which says it all- would recommend.
